objectives.title: Create your first Jira issue
objectives.why: Turning a task into a tracked issue is what makes it visible to everyone else on the project.

objectives.title: Search with JQL before opening a new issue
objectives.why: A duplicate issue splits the conversation about the same work across two tickets.

objectives.title: Leave a comment for your teammates
objectives.why: Context that lives only in your head is context nobody else can act on.

objectives.title: Move an issue through its workflow
objectives.why: An issue that never changes status might as well not be tracked.

objectives.title: Log time against real work
objectives.why: Worklogs are what turn a sprint retro from a guess into a measurement.

objectives.title: Publish a Confluence page
objectives.why: Documentation that isn't published is just a draft nobody else can find.

objectives.title: Search Confluence with CQL before writing a new page
objectives.why: Half of 'we need docs for this' is actually 'we already have docs for this and can't find them.'

objectives.title: Update a page instead of leaving it stale
objectives.why: A wrong doc is worse than no doc — people trust it and act on the wrong thing.

objectives.title: Leave feedback directly on a doc
objectives.why: A comment tied to the exact paragraph gets resolved faster than one sent over chat.

objectives.title: Review or manage a Bitbucket pull request
objectives.why: Code review is where most real collaboration happens — approving, commenting, or merging closes the loop.

objectives.title: Trigger or inspect a Bitbucket pipeline
objectives.why: Knowing a pipeline's status beats assuming your change built and deployed cleanly.

objectives.title: Respond to an on-call alert
objectives.why: Acknowledging, escalating, or closing an alert is the difference between an incident being handled and just sitting there.

objectives.title: Catalog a service in Compass
objectives.why: An uncatalogued service is invisible to ownership, on-call, and dependency tooling.

bestPractices.title: Look up the real account ID instead of guessing it
bestPractices.why: Account IDs aren't derivable from a name or email — guessing one wrong means a comment or assignment silently goes to the wrong person, or fails outright.

bestPractices.title: Check available transitions before moving an issue
bestPractices.why: Workflows restrict which status changes are legal — checking first avoids a rejected transition or, worse, skipping a required step like review.

bestPractices.title: Check required fields before creating an issue
bestPractices.why: Every project can require different fields per issue type — checking first avoids a failed create or a half-filled-in issue.
